scope: Evidence-backed recovery of externally submitted exact adapter payloads and reserved payer nonce consumers; historical signer-generation metadata.

decisions.chain_evidence: Verify actual signed raw transaction/hash, recovered sender, nonce, chain, canonical block transaction index, receipt/log identities and confirmation depth. Reverify restored observations. Bounded explicit block scans do not release anything on absence.
decisions.nonce_consumption: A transaction must consume exactly the reserved payer nonce, including a reserved-only crash. Matching calls still need semantic proof; unrelated/reverted execution cannot mark any bet paid or release accepted exposure. Only processing claims/nonce are advanced.
decisions.external_payment: An exact planned batch/queue/completion call submitted by another sender requires full semantic proof. Proof and association commit atomically, but the payer nonce and processing lane remain held until separately proven consumed.
decisions.nonce_cleanup: Cancellation or revert after proven external payment closes only the payer lane; its receipt remains distinct from the actual payment proof. The external proof is not charged/committed again.
decisions.source_authority: New financial signing still requires the live fenced canonical writer. Read-only proof of an already executed signed contract call needs no live writer or signing key.
decisions.classification: Unknown successful protocol calls, protocol-fund movements/approvals, malformed or unknown USDC effects remain unclassified and cannot be auto-released. Only the adapter exact signed payloads are adopted as matching.
decisions.historical_generation: Queue receipts lack a typed digest marker. Asserted generation is checked against historical versions before/after the block and the complete ordered rotation sequence. Later same-block rotations do not alter the earlier direct custody call generation.

resolved_finding.issue: Earlier queue verification could accept self-consistently changed asserted signer-generation/digest metadata while retaining actual calldata/signatures. Successful immutable contract execution still bound the real owner, outcome and stake; no different payout was demonstrated.
resolved_finding.resolution: Derive the actual transaction generation using pre/post-block versions and ordered rotation events, then compare it to the asserted generation.
evidence: actual queue proof with self-consistent false generation rejected
unit before/after rotation trace derives transaction generation
unit missing/duplicate/removed/wrong-block or same-transaction rotations rejected

executed_checks: actual unrelated nonce consumer after a reservation-only crash found by bounded block scan
unconfirmed/wrong historical nonce/wrong block index/altered raw payload rejected
nonce audit terminal-write failure retained active lane and claims
unrelated consumption left accepted exposure and paid-ticket count unchanged
another relayer executed an actual zero-net batch of two native outcomes
different relayer cannot be adopted as our nonce consumer
external association failure rolled back payment proof
external proof recorded while owned nonce remained active; resend/replacement rejected
separate cancellation closed owned nonce without recharging the externally proven payment
actual independently submitted matching refund adopted at its reserved nonce through writer disconnection/pause/rotation
five actual accepted native stages retain 2 USDC aggregate profit and 0.1 USDC daily fee
existing own-send replacement/cancellation/original-win/void and atomic-proof recovery retained
terminal nonce and external-payment adoption retries reverify original evidence without rewriting after payer lane closes
limitations: exact adapter authorization/calldata only; changed authorizations, partial batches, single non-adapter resolve calls and governance multicalls require incident handling
idle or multiple nonce gaps do not support blind reset/automatic skipping
128 blocks per explicit discovery window is a candidate operational guard
unprotected legacy transactions and unclassified protocol effects are not automatically adopted
honest authenticated canonical RPC and durable PostgreSQL remain infrastructure assumptions
target-chain fee/finality/scaling, live worker/ingress/capital projection and independent review remain open
